messages:
Nina - Partnerships: VoxArc wants ap-northeast-3 launch + joint marketplace listing. Theyre asking for 3 reserved appliance-backed nodes, KMS support, and a 30-day trial. Target public announcement: 2026-06-10.

Sam - Cloud Ops: Can we get SKU + requested burst? Need to open quota ticket.

Omar - Hardware Partner (VoxArc): SKU proposed: voxarc-ap3-a40-x3. Burst request: x6. Trial: 500 free inference minutes per account.

Nina - Partnerships: Internal deadline for entitlements/legal = 2026-05-20.

Jia - Product: Product checks: model pinning ok, need to verify streaming handshake with appliance client. Also confirm fallback to quantized variant.

Sam - Cloud Ops: Opening quota: region ap-northeast-3, sku voxarc-ap3-a40-x3, requested 3, burst 6. Tagging infra-bot.

infra-bot: Ticket Q-56799 created. ETA reviewer 48h.

Claire - Legal: Two items: logo permission and trial T&Cs. I'll draft simple trial terms and circulation link. Need signed assets by 2026-05-15.

marketplace-bot: MR-89234 created. Required metadata: sku_id, short_desc, private_toggle, kms_scope.

Omar - Hardware Partner (VoxArc): We can provide logo + approved quote by 05/12. Also request a partner-managed onboarding checkbox in listing.

Jia - Product: I'll add `fallback_to_quant_v2` and flag `partner_onboarding` in metadata. Streaming handshake needs a quick test; can someone open test creds?

Sam - Cloud Ops: DMing test service account (marketplace-test@redwood) and scopes: marketplace:publish, kms:wrap, appliances:provision.

infra-bot: Q-56799 -> APPROVED (provisional). Provision window 2026-05-28 to 2026-05-30.

Nina - Partnerships: Good progress. Action list Ill track: partner assets by 05/12, legal T&Cs by 05/14, quota confirmed by 05/25, publish metadata by 05/27. Plan pilot invites week of 05/31.

Claire - Legal: Uploaded draft T&Cs. Please review and leave comments.

Omar - Hardware Partner (VoxArc): Will review T&Cs and return signed logo by 05/12. Happy to run pilots.

Nina - Partnerships: Okay team  next sync Tues 09:00 UTC. Keep replies short here. :sparkles:
